howToRun: npm run test:e2e (uses the installed VS Code; a dedicated profile under .local/e2e-vscode)

checks.name: analysis result is registered
checks.detail: no analysis id in the store

finding: The extension host starts, all seven commands register, and the workspace loads. The Quick analysis does not leave a result in the store inside the test instance, so the remaining two checks fail. The suite now records diagnostics for that failure (analyzer DLL present, dotnet version, configured mode) so the next run names the cause.

environment.extensionDependency: The product declares ms-dotnettools.vscode-dotnet-runtime as a hard dependency. The marketplace install into the fresh profile did not produce files; the extension was copied from the user profile instead.
environment.flakiness: A second run of the same harness aborted without producing a report, so the harness needs the watchdog and a report-based verdict before it can gate CI.

notVerifiedHere: Why the analysis result does not register in the test instance (needs the next run with the diagnostics).
Untrusted-workspace behaviour (the launcher disables workspace trust).
